claim: Scrape ordinary food remnants rather than pre-wash normally soiled items.
evidence_excerpt: Do not pre-wash items with loosely attached food soil. / Simply scrape leftover food soils off of dishware before loading.
limitations: Also paragraphs2 and9. Remove food particles, bones, toothpicks and excess grease. Burned/baked/starchy soils are pretreatment exceptions. This is model-specific guidance.

claim: A dishwasher cycle can run for hours.
evidence_excerpt: Most dishwasher cycle times can last anywhere from 1.5 to 4 hours, depending on the cycle.
limitations: General process context, not an exact measured Bosch program duration. Duration alone does not establish water efficiency.

claim: Water collects at the bottom rather than filling the whole tub, and the inlet does not run throughout the cycle.
evidence_excerpt: signals the inlet valve to close. The dishwasher only fills with water at the bottom of the tub.
limitations: Also paragraph5's bathtub comparison. General manufacturer explanation, not a Bosch plumbing schematic or a claim of only one fill in the program.

claim: A circulation pump sends water through the spray arms.
evidence_excerpt: the circulation pump pushes water into the arms
limitations: General process explanation supports this fictional spray-arm unit; exact arm layout varies by model.

claim: Water entering this model's spray arms is filtered.
evidence_excerpt: designed to filter 100% of the water entering the spray arms
limitations: Filtering is not sterilization or removal of every dissolved contaminant. This is the cited Bosch design.

claim: Hot water, detergent and jets contribute to cleaning.
evidence_excerpt: a combination of wash systems, heat and detergent to help clean your dishes / washes away food particles and debris
limitations: No temperature, disinfection or universal cleaning guarantee is asserted. Heating arrangements vary by model.

claim: Dirty wash water drains and a subsequent rinse sprays clean water.
evidence_excerpt: Once the wash cycle has finished, the dirty water and debris are filtered out ... The rinse cycle sprays clean water
limitations: Simplified phases; not a claim about every fill or that water is never recirculated during rinsing.

claim: Sink pre-rinsing adds water use before the dishwasher cycle.
evidence_excerpt: Rinsing dishes before loading them in the dishwasher increases the total water and energy used.
limitations: ENERGY STAR guidance concerns certified units; Bosch separately supports this example's ordinary-soil practice. No numeric or universal handwashing comparison.

claim: Avoid nesting bowls and orient their insides toward spray.
evidence_excerpt: insides of bowls, pots and pans are facing the spray arms. / Avoid nesting and contact points between dishes.
limitations: Also paragraph9. The particular dirty bowl is staged, not evidence that nesting alone caused its condition.

claim: Items protruding below the rack can block an arm; arms need unobstructed movement.
evidence_excerpt: Ensure items do not protrude through the bottom of the racks and block the spray arms.
limitations: Also paragraph9. The utensil collision and gentle arm turn with machine off are fictional observations, not a universal service procedure.

claim: This model's filter can be removed, cleaned as directed, reinstalled and locked.
evidence_excerpt: remove the entire filter system / Rinse the filters under running water and use a soft brush / lock into place ... until the marking arrows align
limitations: Removal also appears in paragraph8. Follow complete model instructions; no abrasive brushes/steel wool, no operation without reinstalled filter, no all-model assumption.

claim: Retained food and poorer cleaning can indicate that this model's filter needs maintenance.
evidence_excerpt: Depending on use habits and water hardness, the filter system will require some maintenance / food soils remaining on the filter system / A drop in cleaning performance
limitations: The particular debris is fictional. No universal interval or claim that cleaning resolves every fault.

claim: Burned-on, baked-on or starchy soils receive manual-directed pretreatment.
evidence_excerpt: Pre-treat items having burned-on, baked-on or starchy soils.
limitations: Script says stubborn or starchy and defers treatment to the manual; it does not require all dishes to be washed at the sink.

claim: Use detergent specifically designed for dishwashers.
evidence_excerpt: Use only detergent specifically designed for dishwashers. / Do not use hand dishwashing products in your dishwasher.
limitations: No universal dose; amount depends on the model manual, product directions and water hardness.

claim: Select a cycle appropriate to the dishware and soil.
evidence_excerpt: Auto ... ideal for mixed dishware and food soils / Normal ... normally soiled dishes / Select a cycle and desired options.
limitations: No universally correct program or claim that changing cycle alone caused the clean retest.
